name: Rakshasa Subdomain
body:
Rakshasas are a race of lawful evil native outsiders.

Associated Domain(s): Evil, Law.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the touch of evil power of the Evil domain or the touch of law power of the Law domain.

Lowly Being (Sp)

With a touch, you impose your superiority of caste on a creature, forcing it to serve you. The creature must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + ½ your cleric level + your Wisdom bonus) or it is dominated, as dominate person, for a number of rounds equal to ½ your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier, but you can never dominate more than one creature at the same time.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—detect thoughts, 2nd—alter self, 5th—dominate person.
